recommended_module: Controlled Active Observation Control Integration around Field Perception Orchestrator
why_not_new_owner: Field Perception Orchestrator already contains information-gap, observation-goal, region, capability, budget, stop, and re-observation candidates.
Observation Gateway already owns evidence normalization/admission and A Route Orchestration already owns lifecycle/handoff sequencing.
Model Manager already owns model/provider candidate routing and admission/resource/fallback references.
Creating Active Observation Governance would duplicate demand/capability planning semantics and risk a semantic super-owner.
module_scope: typed handoff from Context/World/Intent/Task/Safety to Field Perception Orchestrator
provider session start/stop/revoke adapter around existing admission/runtime owners
Observation Gateway feedback to next cognitive cycle
exit_criteria: R01-R12 pass as product-level controlled acceptance baseline
No provider starts from frame arrival or Gateway admission alone
One scoped demand can end in STOP, DEFER, REDIRECT, SWITCH, or RECONSIDER with trace
Sufficiency is task/information-need-relative and not a confidence threshold
No downstream owner mutation occurs through provider or observation control paths
